plan: Given my private value of $20, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly below my value to ensure a win while minimizing payment. Assuming rational agents, they will bid close to their values, likely averaging around $10. To outbid them, I should bid slightly above this average. A bid of $15 is strategic; it is high enough to likely win, but leaves room for profit if the second-highest bid is lower.
